architecture.summary: Rename the Connect with radio label from Desktop Apps to Desktop and Web Apps. The desktop category value, exported declarations, app choices, selection state, events, and HTTP interactions stay the same. The existing acceptance scenario checks the new label and keeps its selection and request checks. User and design documentation use the new label. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views remain accurate: this copy change adds no owner, dependency, external integration, boundary, or contract guarantee. No registry edit or architecture decision is needed.
